description: Released-weights Medverse (no finetune) evaluated on the 7 held-out eval-expansion sources (docs/datasets/{isles22,shifts_ms,msd_hippocampus,msd_prostate,atlas_v2,gnc_kidney_lesions,hu_lwk1}.md) in 3 modes each -- harness coarse-to-fine cascade with data.cascade_query_prior=none, the same cascade with the default query_prior=pred (feeding Medverse's own prior-level prediction forward as its NA-ICL prior), and Medverse's native single-pass autoregressive predict() at data.image_size=[256,256,256] (no harness cascade at all) -- plus 2 more sources (flare22, nasalseg) added the next morning in native-AR mode only. 21+2 = 23 valid runs; a 24th run (hhtoi93b, msd_hippocampus prior=none) was killed mid-eval by a session interruption at 74% and is excluded, superseded by its resumed rerun (0nngi66g). Per-source cascade ladders: hu_lwk1 [6,3,1]mm, isles22 [3,1.5]mm, shifts_ms [6,3,1.5]mm, msd_hippocampus [6,3,0.5]mm, msd_prostate [6,3,0.75]mm, atlas_v2 [6,3,1.9]mm, gnc_kidney [6,3,1.2]mm. See docs/datasets/eval_expansion_status.md ('Medverse released-weights sweep') for the full writeup this export backs.
